message.content: The CSV importer is 800 lines of spaghetti. Split it into parse → validate → load stages.

content.text: Refactored into three composable stages with a shared `ImportContext`. Each stage is independently testable; the validator now reports ALL row errors instead of dying on the first one. 34 new unit tests, all green.

lastPrompt: Split the importer into parse → validate → load.
